main_character.name: Raka
main_character.description: Young adult male host with thick slightly tousled black hair, expressive dark eyes, tan-brown explorer jacket over a plain black shirt, compass pendant necklace, and a small globe-shaped Sejarah Dunia emblem on the jacket. Friendly, cheerful, curious, expressive. Preserve the same face, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and signature accessories across every episode.
